metadata.description: CloudzLab team catalog: Salesforce skills from forcedotcom/sf-skills that Salesforce does not ship in an official plugin, grouped into team plugins.

plugins.name: sf-platform-extras
plugins.description: General Salesforce tools not in an official plugin: official docs lookup, ApexGuru scan, SLDS design system, org shapes and snapshots, data masking, AI model setup, Flow planning, diagrams and extra Agentforce setup. Includes sf-plugin-finder and sf-npx-cleanup.

plugins.name: sf-experience-extras
plugins.description: Experience Cloud site configuration beyond components: LWR sites, portals, custom domains, navigation menus, notifications, Lightning Out and page setup.

plugins.name: sf-data360
plugins.description: Data 360 (Data Cloud): data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, segments, calculated insights, activations, semantic models and knowledge graphs.

plugins.name: sf-field-service
plugins.description: Field Service: scheduling policies, work plans and rules, data capture forms, mobile branding and technician pre-work briefs.

plugins.name: sf-omnistudio
plugins.description: OmniStudio: OmniScripts, FlexCards, Integration Procedures, DataMappers, EPC product catalog and DataPack deployment.

plugins.name: sf-commerce
plugins.description: Commerce beyond B2B storefront components: B2B store setup, delivery estimates, BOPIS, fees, returns, merchant catalogs and buyer groups, merchant insights and React storefronts.

plugins.name: sf-service-itsm
plugins.description: IT Service Management and other Service Cloud setup: incidents, CMDB, IT service agents, Slack and Teams channels, SLAs, contact center and service catalog.

plugins.name: sf-consumer-goods
plugins.description: Consumer Goods Cloud: store visits and activities, trade promotions, promotion dashboards and data sync.

plugins.name: sf-crm-analytics
plugins.description: CRM Analytics and Tableau Next: dashboards, report notifications, sharing inheritance and Tableau Next setup.

plugins.name: sf-industries-misc
plugins.description: Smaller packs: Communications Cloud, Nonprofit (fundraising, volunteers), Life Sciences, Insurance, Sales (call scoring) and Marketing.
